name: Natsume Hibiki
source:
Hibiki is very friendly and easygoing. She loves dolphins and swimming is a passion of hers. Because [url=/c98254]Ikari[/url] is burning with competitive spirit and frequently challenges her into matches, Hibiki is often tired. Hibiki's swimming ability is at a national level, but because she doesn't care about speed, it's rare to see her go all out.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
